name: yoursite.com: copy this file to brands/<site>.json and change the colours to the site's brand
accent: main brand colour (gradient end, buttons, tiles)
sky: bright tint for carets and legend dots
labelAfter: darker brand shade for the right/after label
legendAfter: brand shade for the second legend item
headline: very dark brand shade for big headlines
markUrl: optional: URL of the site's own square icon (e.g. its apple-touch-icon), used by the site mark
markName: optional: the site name shown next to the mark
